case_semantics: All 32 complete-register cohorts compared against unfiltered public API outputs; eight named edge-case cohorts also queried through the nr_registro public filter in both source and dataset layers. Two ambiguous literal exponent expressions have independently expected null value/unit without inferred arithmetic.

format_details.cases: A complete-register cohort has product, ordered components and every authorization occurrence; r2_ids lists each public view covered, query is the exact register selector. public_filter_exercised distinguishes direct filter calls from comparisons within unfiltered public API output.
format_details.oracles: gzip JSONL, original logical CSV record starting at 1 and physical line; full/direct product and authorization rows, selected composition rows. Storage SHA differs from decoded original only by compression.
format_details.scope: Eight direct technical fields for all 2992; full ten fields for nine technical cohorts; all 12 formulated and ten authorization fields; all nine composition fields for 57 components in 32 cohorts.
